# Simple Editor

> A fast, free video editor for Windows: one small exe, no installer. Rust (egui), Windows Media Foundation and ffmpeg. It hosts an MCP server so AI agents can edit the live, running project.

## For AI agents

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/agents.md): workflow, conventions, verification, how to drive the running app over MCP, releasing
- [MCP tool catalogue and Luau API](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/docs/customizing.md): every tool with its arguments
- [Architecture](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, project format, render pipeline
- [Goals and budgets](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/goals.md): binary size, dependency and UX rules
- [Library file formats](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/library/README.md): shader effects and transitions, LUTs, HTML layers (`se:` meta tags), icons, assistant skills
- [Changelog](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## For users

- [User guide](https://kashtheking.com/simple-editor/guide/)
- [Download](https://github.com/KashTheKing/simple-editor/releases/latest)
- [Report a bug](https://kashtheking.com/simple-editor/guide/report-a-bug) (or Help > Report a Bug in the app)
